card.name: Final word completing a medical phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a medical noun phrase in warning text, just before the phrase closes, e.g. 'suboptimal', 'symptoms', 'function', 'syndrome', 'treatment'. It fires in drug label warnings and precautions.

modes.label: Completing a condition phrase
modes.description: Final noun that ends a clinical condition or sign, such as symptoms, syndrome, function.
modes.example: inadequately treated extrapyramidal signs and<< symptoms>> (EPS).

modes.label: Ending a descriptive word
modes.description: An adjective or noun ending that finishes a clause, such as essential, nature, or the end of suboptimal.
modes.example: If the response to an opioid antagonist is subopt<<imal>> or only brief in nature

modes.label: Treatment or lab term endings
modes.description: Final piece of a therapy or lab finding term.
modes.example: during the initiation of NSAID<< treatment>> and throughout the course of therapy.
